_comment: Contoso University (ASP.NET MVC 5, EF 6 Code First) scenario: the pages experiments/wf4c/run-linux.ps1 and verify-windows.ps1 take snapshots of in the converted app, compared with corpora/parity/contoso.golden-webforms.json (recorded from the original app on IIS: corpora/record-webforms-golden.ps1). Both start from the initializer's seed (8 students; EF 6 creates the database): the student made here has ID 9. The HTML is compared too (compareSource; the antiforgery token masked: sourceMasks).
_sourceMasksComment: The antiforgery token (AntiForgeryToken in every form) differs every time. Not here: the controller's 400 and 404 (HttpStatusCodeResult, HttpNotFound) answered by IIS's detailed error page, which FrameworkOnCore writes simply (the user's decision, 2026-10-16).

steps._why: The seed's students from EF 6: their enrollment dates as the server's culture writes a DateTime (DisplayFor).
A date that is not one: the browser's unobtrusive validation shows MVC's message for a DateTime (its client data type validation).
Saved (EF 6), back to the list: the date read from the form (model binding of a DateTime) and written back.
The edit form: the date in its text box as EditorFor writes a DateTime.
